title: AgentThreadActionResult
description: References fixed at the thread action commit, preserved on replay.

executionId.description: Execution committed for turnId in threadId by foreground admission.

taskId.description: Task atomically created by the shared detached launch mechanism.

threadId.description: Created conversation or the target conversation of send/start.

turnId.description:
Saved message or admitted turn in threadId. For a detached launch this
is the parent admission, never the executing child turn.
